Many Bounty Hunters are introduced in this Season.{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20090928/index.html|text=The Rise of the Bounty Hunters Begins!}} It began airing in the UK on [[October 24]] on [[Wikipedia:Sky Movies|Sky Movies]], and in Spain on [[November 20]] on [[Wikipedia:Antena 3 (Spain)|Antena.Neox]]. On [[April 4]], Cartoon Network began the airing of the series to all Latin America.
